items.author: li.w
items.title: A1 ARM latency experiment log
items.body:
Experiment log, project A1 (low-latency defect detection).
2026-01-23 Baseline FP32: 180 ms, 92.4 mAP, 81.0 mAP under 8 px.
2026-02-11 Exp 1 PTQ INT8 (500 calibration images): 41 ms, 84.1 mAP, 58.3 mAP under 8 px. Failed on accuracy.
2026-03-06 Exp 2 pruning 50%: 88 ms, 90.9 mAP. Pruning 70%: 61 ms, 86.2 mAP. Failed on latency.
2026-04-03 Exp 3 QAT + distillation, first block FP16: 46 ms, 91.8 mAP, 79.6 mAP under 8 px. Passed.
2026-04-06 Seeds x3: 91.6 to 91.9 mAP, 45 to 47 ms.
Open question: whether the same recipe holds for the reflective-surface model in A2.

items.author: mei.c
items.title: A2 reflective surfaces results table
items.body:
A2 results. Dataset: 180 labelled chrome and aluminium images, 5-fold cross-validation.
Exp 1 fine-tune: recall 0.62, FPR 31%.
Exp 2 synthetic highlights (2,000 images): recall 0.66, FPR 18%.
Exp 3 masking + prototypical head: recall 0.81, FPR 9%.
Masking only: FPR 14%.
Conclusion so far: highlight masking matters more than model choice. Recall target of 0.90 not reached.
